dialogues.speaker: Hastily-Written Cargo Invoice
dialogues.text: "The golden canary is still alive. This batch has failed. Our big client doesn't know, but will sooner or later. I'll look for the northerners to get a new batch. Come see me soon at the usual spot."

dialogues.speaker: Hastily-Written Cargo Invoice
dialogues.text: "The wildcat is very fierce and tastes gamey. If you can't sell it, do not keep it."
